title: Things worth keeping: a beginning
excerpt: Introducing KELTNER, a journal of timeless style, beautiful estates, and things worth keeping.
author: Audrey Goddard

children.text: KELTNER begins with a simple question: what is worth keeping? A well-cut coat, a building that rewards a second look, a journey remembered for its smallest details. These are the things this journal will make room for.
Here, style, estates, cars, and travel belong to the same conversation. Each offers a way to notice how things are made, why they matter, and what gives them lasting interest.

Some stories will be practical guides. Others will take a closer look at an object, a place, or a design decision. The aim is to leave with something useful to consider, rather than another list of things to buy.
Keltner is my father’s middle name. Borrowing it for this publication gives the project a connection to home as it begins to look outward.
This is the first page of that project. Thank you for being here at the beginning.
